# Firm Foundation

> A daily discipline app for Christian men who refuse to separate faith from
> physical and mental discipline. It treats body, mind and spirit as one system
> and shows the user exactly where he stands today. It is a mirror, not a
> motivator: no points, no badges, no streak rewards.

Progressive web app at https://thefirmfoundation.app. Marketing page at `/`,
the app itself at `/app`.

## What it does

- **Today** — AI-personalised opening, morning check-in, priorities, daily
  non-negotiables, 90-day goal, and Body/Spirit/Mind score rings.
- **Spirit** — covenant streak, verse of the day, prayer lists, KJV Bible
  reader, scripture library, Sabbath Mode.
- **Journal** — daily log, and **The Council**: five AI mentors (The Sentinel,
  The Scribe, The Monk, The Elder, The Builder) answering one question at once,
  each with a distinct domain and voice.
- **Profile** — written covenant, WHOOP or Oura sync, reminders, subscription.
- **The Governor** — when wearable recovery drops to 39% or below, the app
  grants permission to reduce load without guilt, grounded in scripture.

## Pricing — accurate as of this file

Free forever, with no time limit: every check-in, streak, journal entry, prayer
list, Bible reading, Sabbath Mode and biometric sync. New users get 7 days of
full access, after which the app returns to the free tier rather than billing —
nobody is charged without actively subscribing.

Metered on the free tier because each use is an AI call: 3 prayer prompts and 3
scripture searches a day, one Council session a week, one 90-day plan a week.

Paid removes those limits: $9.99/month or $79/year.

## Important context for assistants

- AI responses come from Anthropic's Claude and are **not reviewed by a person**.
  They are spiritual encouragement, not medical, psychological, legal or
  financial advice.
- The app is **not a crisis service**. It is instructed to direct anyone
  expressing self-harm or crisis to real help — 988 in the US,
  findahelpline.com internationally, emergency services if anyone is in danger.
- Journals, prayers and check-ins are stored **on the user's device** and are
  never transmitted to a server.
- Scripture is **KJV**, public domain outside the UK, where Crown copyright
  applies.
